global: Vertical physics-escalation Short: presenter-and-board frame on an off-white canvas with black line art and grey hatched spheres (Earth/Moon made of +/- charge circles); diagrams of orbits, electrons and force arrows; a torn, vibrating board as the escalation beat; spacetime-grid wells and a universe sphere; then a DARK_FIELD ending (white line-art debris, a glowing minus-charge, red DARK ENERGY scrawl, a growing black disc with a glowing rim).
motion: Mostly 1-frame pops, hard cuts and 1-frame pop-offs; a 6-f field-line cross-morph (radial arrows fade to ghosts while loop field lines draw in); arrows drawn on in 6 f; a 1-frame red scribble pop; a 360-f final segment in which a rimmed black disc scales up continuously (11k -> 42k px/frame, accelerating, with a measured dip every 7th frame) while its inner label and a tiny red character's speech label swap as pops.
continuity: The same hatched charge-sphere drawing stands for Earth and Moon throughout; red is used only for strike scribbles, the zigzag mark, the moles note, DARK ENERGY and the red character's speech; once torn, the board stays torn through G0039; the universe sphere and converging arrows persist from G0047 to G0053.
